_comment: What a person says about their board, and which tool must answer. Grouped by FAMILY: the expected tool is language-independent, only the phrasing changes, so each expectation is written ONCE and checked against six utterances. Two consumers: the deterministic test (does the vocabulary reach the router and the manifests? in CI, no network) and the on-demand measurement (utterance -> tool, through a real model — `task workboard:corpus:measure`). The NEGATIVE families are the point of the exercise: a ticket is confused with a provider to-do, a timed notification and a scheduled routine, and a corpus that only proves the happy cases would be a corpus that proves nothing.

utterances.fr: Mets sur mon tableau qu'il faut réserver la salle pour le 20
utterances.en: Put on my board that I need to book the room for the 20th
utterances.de: Setz auf mein Board, dass ich den Raum für den 20. buchen muss
utterances.es: Pon en mi tablero que hay que reservar la sala para el 20
utterances.it: Metti sulla mia bacheca che devo prenotare la sala per il 20
utterances.zh-CN: 在我的任务板上加一条：需要预订20号的会议室

utterances.fr: Crée un ticket pour LIA : trouve-moi trois salles pour douze personnes
utterances.en: Create a ticket for LIA: find me three rooms for twelve people

utterances.it: Crea un ticket per LIA: trovami tre sale per dodici persone
utterances.zh-CN: 给 LIA 创建一个任务：帮我找三个能容纳十二人的会议室

utterances.fr: Crée un ticket « relire le contrat » et confie-le à Marie
utterances.en: Create a ticket “review the contract” and hand it to Marie
utterances.de: Erstelle ein Ticket „Vertrag prüfen“ und gib es an Marie
utterances.es: Crea un ticket «revisar el contrato» y dáselo a Marie
utterances.it: Crea un ticket «rivedere il contratto» e affidalo a Marie
utterances.zh-CN: 创建一个「审阅合同」的任务，交给 Marie

utterances.fr: Passe le ticket « réserver la salle » en terminé
utterances.en: Move the ticket “book the room” to done
utterances.de: Setz das Ticket „Raum buchen“ auf erledigt
utterances.es: Pasa el ticket «reservar la sala» a terminado
utterances.it: Sposta il ticket «prenotare la sala» in completato
utterances.zh-CN: 把「预订会议室」这个任务移到已完成

utterances.fr: Ajoute un commentaire sur le ticket de la salle : le devis est arrivé
utterances.en: Add a comment on the room ticket: the quote has arrived
utterances.de: Füge dem Raum-Ticket einen Kommentar hinzu: das Angebot ist da
utterances.es: Añade un comentario al ticket de la sala: ha llegado el presupuesto
utterances.it: Aggiungi un commento al ticket della sala: è arrivato il preventivo
utterances.zh-CN: 在会议室那个任务上加个评论：报价已经收到了

utterances.fr: Qu'est-ce qu'il y a sur mon tableau en ce moment ?
utterances.en: What is on my workboard right now?
utterances.de: Was steht gerade auf meinem Aufgabenboard?
utterances.es: ¿Qué hay ahora mismo en mi tablero de trabajo?
utterances.it: Che cosa c'è adesso sulla mia bacheca?
utterances.zh-CN: 我的任务板上现在有什么？

utterances.fr: Quels tickets sont en retard sur mon tableau ?
utterances.en: Which tickets on my board are overdue?
utterances.de: Welche Tickets auf meinem Board sind überfällig?
utterances.es: ¿Qué tickets de mi tablero están atrasados?
utterances.it: Quali ticket della mia bacheca sono in ritardo?
utterances.zh-CN: 我的任务板上有哪些任务已经逾期了？

utterances.fr: Où en est le ticket « réserver la salle » ?
utterances.en: Where does the ticket “book the room” stand?
utterances.de: Wie steht es um das Ticket „Raum buchen“?
utterances.it: A che punto è il ticket «prenotare la sala»?
utterances.zh-CN: 「预订会议室」这个任务现在什么情况？

utterances.fr: Supprime le ticket « réserver la salle » de mon tableau
utterances.en: Delete the ticket “book the room” from my board
utterances.de: Lösche das Ticket „Raum buchen“ von meinem Board
utterances.es: Elimina el ticket «reservar la sala» de mi tablero
utterances.it: Elimina il ticket «prenotare la sala» dalla mia bacheca
utterances.zh-CN: 把「预订会议室」这个任务从我的任务板上删除

families.name: negative_provider_task
families._why: A to-do in the person's own provider account is NOT a ticket on the board — the single most likely confusion.

utterances.fr: Ajoute « acheter du café » à ma liste de tâches
utterances.en: Add “buy coffee” to my task list
utterances.de: Füge „Kaffee kaufen“ zu meiner Aufgabenliste hinzu
utterances.es: Añade «comprar café» a mi lista de tareas
utterances.it: Aggiungi «comprare il caffè» alla mia lista di attività
utterances.zh-CN: 把「买咖啡」加到我的待办清单里

families.name: negative_reminder
families._why: A notification at a given moment is a reminder, not a column on a board.

utterances.fr: Rappelle-moi d'appeler le traiteur demain à 10h
utterances.en: Remind me to call the caterer tomorrow at 10
utterances.de: Erinnere mich morgen um 10 Uhr daran, den Caterer anzurufen
utterances.es: Recuérdame llamar al catering mañana a las 10
utterances.it: Ricordami di chiamare il catering domani alle 10
utterances.zh-CN: 明天上午十点提醒我给餐饮公司打电话

families.name: negative_routine
families._why: Something that repeats on a schedule is a routine the scheduler runs, never a ticket.

utterances.fr: Chaque lundi matin, fais-moi le point sur mes mails
utterances.en: Every Monday morning, give me a summary of my emails
utterances.de: Gib mir jeden Montagmorgen eine Zusammenfassung meiner E-Mails
utterances.es: Cada lunes por la mañana, hazme un resumen de mis correos
utterances.it: Ogni lunedì mattina, fammi il punto sulle mie mail
utterances.zh-CN: 每周一早上给我总结一下我的邮件
